en: All characters within a |burst 2| area are knocked back [b]2 SPACES[/b] and must pass a |hull save| or be knocked |prone|.

Throw a Concussion Grenade within |range 5|. All characters within a |blast 2| area must pass a |hull save| or be pushed [b]2 SPACES[/b] away from the center on failure or [b]1 SPACE[/b] on a success.

All characters within a |burst 1| area must pass an |engineering save|. On failture they take |4 heat| and are |jammed| until the end of their next turn. On a success, they take |2 heat| and they are not |jammed|.

Throw a Shock Grenade within |range 5|. All characters within a |blast 1| area must pass an |engineering save|. On failture they take |2 heat| and are |impaired| until the end of their next turn. On a success, they are not |impaired|.
Two allied mech characters in |line of sight| and |sensors| gain |3 overshield|.
The GMS Micro-Maintenance Suite activates spare motile ablative and fabrication modules commonly found in combat vehicles to proactive protect key components.
Make a |tech attack| against a hostile character within |sensors| and |line of sight|. On a success, the target takes |4 heat| and is |impaired| and |immobilized| until the end of their next turn
GMS wartime electronic assault packages typically focus on exploiting predicted and cataloged back doors common in mech systems.
